en.headline: Halloween Month events continue across the city on Sunday
en.dek: Special party trams run on designated evenings and Kai Tak Sports Park hosts a market and cosplay activities through the weekend under the Tourism Board campaign.
body: The Hong Kong Tourism Board’s inaugural Hong Kong Halloween Month continues on Sunday with activities in several districts, following Saturday’s street events in Central, Lan Kwai Fong and other areas.

Hongkong Land’s Halloween in Central features nighttime installations at Statue Square Gardens, including a large eyeball display, lit from 4pm to 11.30pm through 31 October. Special party trams operate between Causeway Bay and Sheung Wan on the evenings of 24 and 25 October for passengers in costume who make a qualifying purchase at designated outlets.

At Kai Tak Sports Park, the Dining Cove area holds a Halloween market and cosplay activities on 24 and 25 October from 2pm to 11pm. The main stadium facade carries pumpkin-themed projections for the season. Admission to the park events is free.
The campaign also includes events in Mong Kok and Tsim Sha Tsui East on selected Saturdays, with the final citywide cosplay night scheduled for 31 October.

zh.headline: 萬聖月活動周日繼續 全城多區有節慶安排
zh.dek: 特別派對電車於指定晚間行走，啟德體育園周末舉行市集及Cosplay活動，屬旅發局首辦萬聖月計劃一部分。
body: 香港旅遊發展局首度舉辦的「香港萬聖月」周日繼續在多區進行，繼周六中環、蘭桂坊等地街頭活動後，市民仍可參與相關節慶安排。
置地公司「萬聖狂歡祭．中環」於皇后像廣場花園設有夜間裝置，包括大型眼球展示，每日下午四時至晚上十一時三十分亮燈，直至十月三十一日。特別派對電車於十月二十四及二十五日晚間行走銅鑼灣至上環，穿著萬聖節服裝並於指定商戶消費達標的乘客可免費乘搭。
啟德體育園美食海灣於十月二十四及二十五日下午二時至晚上十一時舉行萬聖節市集及Cosplay活動，主場館外牆亦有南瓜主題投影。園內活動免費入場。
計劃另於旺角及尖沙咀東部設有指定星期六活動，全城Cosplay壓軸夜定於十月三十一日舉行。
